name: – Adnan Dibrani – After Article 8 – Am 85
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Single Market and Customs Programme for the period 2028-2034 and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/444, (EU) 2021/690, (EU) 2021/785, (EU) 2021/847 and (EU) 2021/1077
part_text: Article 8a Co-financing rate 1. The co-financing rate for grants awarded under the programme, where provided in the form of reimbursement of actual eligible costs, shall not exceed 95% of the eligible costs for the objective referred to in Article 3(2), point (-ab), and 80% of the eligible costs for the other objectives referred to in Article 3(2). 2. Any funding in excess of the ceilings set out in paragraph 1 of this Article, up to 100% of the eligible costs, shall only be granted in exceptional and duly justified cases, which shall be defined in the work programmes referred to in Article 11.
